text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told every rule. In supervised learning, we give the computer training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it creates on its own. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might guess whether an email is spam or not. We then check the model's accuracy by comparing its predictions with the real answers. The more good training data we provide, the better the model usually becomes.
